title: Ironkeeper device record
description: One discovered block device. The record describes what the kernel and udev reported; it carries no assessment and no admission verdict. An observation that the device did not provide is absent, never a zero.

schema_version.description: Version of this device contract. Only version 1 is implemented.

kernel_name.description: The kernel name of the block device, for example `sdb`.

device_class.description: The class of the device. Only `physical` devices are active-interrogation targets.

transport.description: The transport the device is attached through.

sysfs_path.description: The sysfs path of the device.

vendor.description: The reported vendor. Absent when the device did not report one.

model.description: The reported model. Absent when the device did not report one.

serial.description: The reported serial number. A weak identifier on its own.

wwn.description: The observed world-wide name, in the form the source reported it.

capacity_bytes.description: The capacity in bytes, as a canonical decimal string. A capacity beyond 2^53 bytes keeps every digit.

logical_block_size.description: The logical block size in bytes.

physical_block_size.description: The physical block size in bytes.

rotational.description: Whether the device reports itself as rotational. Absent when the kernel did not say.

paths.description: The current access paths of the device.

aliases.description: The persistent aliases of the device.

identity.description: The reconciled identity of the device.

confidence.description: How much authority the identity carries.

value.description: The canonical form of the identifier.

original.description: The identifier exactly as it was observed.

duplicate_serial.description: True when another discovered device carries the same serial number.

findings.description: The findings that explain the classification and the exclusions.
